(11) Nothing in this section affects any prohibition or restriction imposed by virtue of any
other enactment on a publication or on matter included in a programme.

(12) In this section—
(a) “publish”, in relation to a report, means publish the report, either by itself or
as part of a newspaper or periodical, for distribution to the public;
(b) expressions cognate with “publish” shall be construed accordingly;
(c) “relevant programme” means a programme included in a programme service,
within the meaning of the M15Broadcasting Act 1990.
